name: Naive UDF Solution (NeuS-based)
aliases: Naive UDF solution based on SDF renderer
definition: A naive approach to volume rendering using Unsigned Distance Fields (UDF) that directly extends the weight function of the NeuS (Neural Implicit Surfaces) method, which was originally designed for Signed Distance Fields (SDF). This method suffers from inherent bias in color rendering, leading to geometric errors such as redundant surfaces and floating noise.
